title: Calendar switches
hints: A value switch compares one expression against each case: `switch day { case "Sat", "Sun": ... }`. Commas list several matching values.
In `DaysInMonth`, group the months: one case for the seven 31-day months, one for the four 30-day months, one for `2`, and `default` for everything else.
Inside `case 2:` use an ordinary `if`: `if year%4 == 0 && (year%100 != 0 || year%400 == 0) { return 29 }` then `return 28`.
